name: Knit Field
desc: A field of hand-knit stitches rendered as shaded yarn — interlocking stockinette V's, raised purl bumps, twisting Aran cables and charted Fair-Isle colorwork — the fabric scrolling like an endless bolt off the needles with a working-row light sweeping up it and a soft wool sheen.

style.doc: aran cables+seed / multi-colour fair-isle / plain stockinette / k2p2 ribbing / dark moss seed-stitch
